data.one_liner: Add vector-based animations with a data format inspired by composable widgets.
data.what_it_does: Provides support for vector data-based animations using widgets like AnimatedVector and AnimatedSequence. It allows defining animations directly in code or generating them from shapeshifter files.
use_when: You want to render and control vector-based animations and icons in Flutter.
You need declarative, immutable definitions for complex vector animations.
avoid_when: You need other types of complex animations like full Rive or Lottie interactive scenes not based on vector drawables.
You require platform-specific native vector animation engines.
strengths: Supports all platforms without platform-specific dependencies.
Includes built-in vector animations and code generation support.
weaknesses: Dependent on external format inspiration like Android's AnimatedVectorDrawable.
File loading via loadFromFile is not supported on platforms lacking dart:io (such as web).
data.setup_notes: Add animated_vector to your pubspec.yaml dependencies. Code generation is optionally available via animated_vector_gen.
